items.title: How to Choose a Compute Platform Your Products Won't Outgrow - with Kyle Larson of IDEMIA
items.summary: As AI accelerates software development, the hardware that software runs on is still often built on a slower, separate track, and the gap shows up in what customers receive. In this episode, Kyle Larson, VP of AI Enablement and Cloud Services at IDEMIA, examines why hardware and software now need to be planned and delivered as one product. He covers how to decide what runs on the device versus in the cloud, why developer tools and simulation need to be in place before physical prototypes arrive, and how to evaluate a long-term compute platform by the ecosystem and supplier roadmap around it. This episode is sponsored by MIPS .
